gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Bambu Lab P1S, ChatGPT's main pick, also works with the newer AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT (up to 4 units in any mix, with an AMS Hub for more than one), or that each AMS 2 Pro on a P1/X1 printer needs its own Bambu power adapter before it can dry filament.
standout_why: I read the cited desktop3dprinters.us multicolor-enclosed list (dated 2026-10-28). It lists the P1S only with the 'AMS (original), optional, 4 spools per unit, up to 4 units'. My read of the page found no statement on whether the P1S takes the AMS 2 Pro or AMS HT, and it states no firmware requirement or power-adapter requirement. It gives chain limits for the P2S (8 units, 20 slots) and H2D Pro, but not the split between AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT for the P2S or H2D/H2S/H2C. The other cited result, 3dprinterlist.com, would not load because of a certificate error, so I could not compare against it. ChatGPT's own answer recommends the P1S Combo for a 'lower budget' and the P2S for 'a newer system', which suggests the newer feeders are only for the P2S.
decides: This supports the P1S Combo as the budget pick rather than changing it. It removes the main reason to pay more for the P2S: a P1S buyer can add an AMS 2 Pro (with drying) or an AMS HT later. Each AMS 2 Pro needs a Bambu power adapter to dry filament, so the page should count that adapter in the upgrade cost. Both Bambu printers top out at 4 feeder units. On the P2S, MatterHackers lists 4 AMS/AMS 2 Pro plus 4 AMS HT, and on the H2D/H2S/H2C it lists 4 AMS/AMS 2 Pro plus 8 AMS HT. That matters only to a buyer who needs more than 16 filaments.

findings.label: Filament systems it accepts and unit limit
findings.value: AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT; 4 units total in any mix; a Buffer is needed for 1 unit and an AMS Hub for more than 1
findings.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Connecting Multiple Bambu Lab AMS Units Across Printer Models (MatterHackers, updated 2026-01-26)
findings.note: The MatterHackers table row 'P1P/P1S/X1/X1C/X1E' reads 'AMS, AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT', '4 total (any mix)', 'Buffer (1 unit), AMS Hub (>1)'. Bambu's own wiki page on this (wiki.bambulab.com/en/p1/manual/p1-firmware-update-support-ams2pro-ams-ht) returned HTTP 402, so I could not read the maker's version.

findings.label: Power requirement for each AMS 2 Pro
findings.value: Each AMS 2 Pro requires a power adapter on P1/X1 printers
findings.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Connecting Multiple Bambu Lab AMS Units Across Printer Models (MatterHackers, updated 2026-01-26)
findings.note: The table note for the P1P/P1S/X1 row reads 'Each AMS 2 Pro requires adapter'.

findings.label: Drying with AMS 2 Pro/AMS HT on P1/X1: maker statement
findings.value: Drying needs the power adapter; a firmware upgrade unlocks drying on P1/X1; an AMS Hub is needed to attach more than one AMS at the same time
findings.source_title: The AMS filament drying feature is now available (Bambu Lab Forum, Announcements, 2025-04-29)
findings.note: Posted by the 'SupportAssistant' account in the Announcements category. It says 'Upgrade to the latest firmware and unlock integrated filament drying with the AMS 2 Pro/HT', 'The power adapter is needed to use the drying function', and 'The AMS Hub is needed to attach more than one AMS unit to the printer, at the same time.' Only user replies give firmware numbers (P1S 01.08.00.00), so I am not reporting a version as a maker fact.

findings.label: Filament systems it accepts and unit limits
findings.value: AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT; up to 4 AMS/AMS 2 Pro plus 4 AMS HT; needs the P2S Buffer and the 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter
findings.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Connecting Multiple Bambu Lab AMS Units Across Printer Models (MatterHackers, updated 2026-01-26)
findings.note: This agrees with the rival's '8 units, 20 slots': 4 × 4-slot AMS + 4 × 1-slot AMS HT = 20 slots.

findings.label: Filament systems it accepts and unit limits
findings.value: AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT; up to 4 AMS/AMS 2 Pro plus 8 AMS HT; buffer built in; 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter needed for 3 or more units
findings.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Connecting Multiple Bambu Lab AMS Units Across Printer Models (MatterHackers, updated 2026-01-26)

findings.label: AMS lite on enclosed printers
findings.value: AMS lite is made only for the A1 series, and an A1 cannot mix AMS lite with AMS/AMS 2 Pro/AMS HT
findings.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Connecting Multiple Bambu Lab AMS Units Across Printer Models (MatterHackers, updated 2026-01-26)
findings.note: The guide says 'AMS lite is designed exclusively for the A1 series.' So no enclosed Bambu printer (P1S, P2S, H2D) takes the cheaper AMS lite.

findings.label: Multicolor capability (maker FAQ)
findings.value: Prints in multiple materials and colors when paired with the QIDI Box
findings.note: Quote: 'When paired with the QIDI Box multi-color unit, the Max4 supports multi-material and multi-color printing.' The FAQ gives no hub, box count or firmware details.
